result.summary: Live provider debug + Qwen reconciliation done. ROOT BUG CONFIRMED AND FIXED: the prior closeout claimed the owner's intended `qwen3.7-plus` was absent from the account catalogue, but its own committed live evidence (audits/evidence/2026-09-24T21-06-25Z-e3-provider-live-identity-probe) lists BOTH `qwen3.7-plus` and `qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26` among 172 ids; the model was wrongly set to `qwen3.8-27b`. Corrected `generic_openai_adapter.py` and `worker_registry.py` to `qwen3.7-plus` (display Qwen3.7-Plus); worker_id `qwen38-27b` preserved as the stable credential-registry key because the credential resolves via credential_target `qwen` (verified via `set_provider_key.py --status`: target is `qwen`, not the worker id), and the owner handover records the credential was provisioned under that key. Deployed the corrected E3 runtime via scripts/deploy_e3_runtime.py, then made exactly ONE bounded real call to the corrected `qwen3.7-plus` (max_tokens=16, one attempt, no retry): model present in live catalogue, HTTP 403 code=AccessDenied.Unpurchased, returned model field null, usage null, E2 row obs-20260924-c378d692 -> genuine ACCOUNT ENTITLEMENT blocker for the intended model, not a Hermes config fault. Tencent Hy3: one bounded GET /v1/models re-probe -> HTTP 401 code 401002, no chat call attempted -> TokenHub credential/product/account mismatch. Mistral: one bounded diagnostic call captured the 429 response headers; provider exposed NO Retry-After/x-ratelimit headers, so transient request-rate limiting cannot be separated from account/tier/monthly quota from provider evidence (the authenticated GET /models still returns 200, so not an auth/adapter fault). GLM, LongCat, MiniMax, StepFun classified from existing committed catalogue + deterministic 402/429-billing evidence with ZERO new calls. Google image: audited the existing 9-call series only - every no-image recurrence carried the provider's own finishReason IMAGE_RECITATION (provider content-side stop, not transport/auth/adapter), and the Stage-2 criterion 'resolved (not intermittent)' is intentionally conservative and was NOT changed; no images generated. Net: no provider became execution-ready; Stage 2 remains NOT ENABLED and no gate was weakened.
